Geometry : L = 120 mm along +x (root at x = 0), H = 10 mm in y, T = 5 mm in z
Mesh     : structured grid of C3D20 20-node hexahedra (24 x 4 x 2 elements)
BCs      : root face x = 0 fully clamped (node set NROOT)
Load     : total Fy = -800 N shared equally by ALL tip-face (x = L) nodes
           (node set NTIP) as concentrated nodal loads (*CLOAD)
Units    : mm, N, MPa, tonne/mm^3

The script only WRITES the deck; it does not run any solver.

NU = 0.3           # Poisson's ratio

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
NI, NJ, NK = 2 * NELX + 1, 2 * NELY + 1, 2 * NELZ + 1

node_id = {}       # (i, j, k) -> node number (1-based)

        for i in range(NI):

                node_order.append((i, j, k))
